title: Pooled campaign on cohort v3 (mid-liquidity band, ranks 401-1,400): top-decile basket selection, the eight literature formulas of campaign v4, no search (checks A and C only), one-shot lane-wide confirmation
rationale: The same daily literature formulas as the parent protocol, scored once each without search, on a different population: cohort v3, the mid-liquidity band of ranks 401-1,400 of the 2026-10-15 liquidity-screen snapshot, which begins where cohort v2's top cut ends. The universe floor is an absolute 20-session median dollar volume of $5 million (with the $10 price floor) instead of the static percentile, because the static reference set is mega-cap and a percentile of it would be meaningless for this band. The decisive cost is 15 bp rather than 5 bp, reflecting the wider spreads of smaller names. Survivorship caveat: membership is today's, so delisted and shrunken smaller names are absent and results for these names are more optimistic than a point-in-time cohort would give. Checks A and C bind (no search, so check B does not apply); the campaign runs only on operator approval, and the lane-wide confirmation window remains unused until a finalist freezes.

families.rationale: Ten-session signed-volume imbalance: buying pressure predicts continuation (Chordia & Subrahmanyam, 2004).
Twelve-month momentum skipping the last month (Jegadeesh & Titman, 1993).
Price-volume divergence: a negative return-volume correlation.
Illiquidity premium with a range-based spread proxy (Amihud, 2002; Corwin & Schultz, 2012).
Short-term reversal is stronger after high volume (Conrad, Hameed & Niden, 1994).
